summary: Fixed Nora sometimes wrongly saying she can't play music because you're not in a voice channel, when you are.
details: A person mapped to more than one Discord account in identity.toml (this operator has two) had play_music pick an arbitrary one of them to check for a live voice channel -- if that wasn't the account currently connected to voice, Nora refused with "you're not in the channel" even though the person plainly was, on their other account.
The music tools now hand the bridge every Discord account a person has, and it tries each one against who is actually sitting in a voice channel right now, rather than guessing which account is real.
